Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute ML coding screen focused on inference / system design + a short coding problem. Can you confirm your timezone and availability for this week?

Preferred slots (your local time OK):
- Thu 7/15 10:00–11:00 (PDT)
- Thu 7/15 14:00–15:00 (PDT) — later afternoon option
- Fri 7/16 09:00–10:00 (PDT)

We use CoderPad for the coding portion and will share a read-only starter repo and a small prompt ahead of time. If you need a specific environment (Python 3.10, JAX or PyTorch), let me know and we'll pre-provision the pad.

Tentative interviewer: Marcus Lin (ML infra). If any conflicts, Soojin is on backup.

Quick ask: please reply with the slot that works and whether you prefer Python or a blank environment.

Hi Sam —

Confirmed for Thu, July 15 at 10:00 AM PDT (13:00 your time). Marcus Lin will be your primary interviewer. Below are short logistics.

What to expect (60 minutes):
- 10m quick intro and role fit questions
- 35–40m live coding on CoderPad (ML-focused problem)
- 10–15m system-design / inference tradeoffs discussion and debrief

Environment: Python 3.10 with PyTorch 2.1 installed. Pad is sandboxed with network access disabled. If you need any specific library, let us know now and we'll pre-install it.

Access & links:
- CoderPad (join at start time): https://coderpad.io/s/RED-CP-7f3b
- Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-srml-sam-20270715
- Ops checklist (for interviewers): https://drive.redwood.ai/sr-ml-screen-checklist

Attachments: coderpad-invite.txt (pad link + quick steps), candidate-ops-checklist.pdf (interviewer rubric)

Day-of instructions: join the calendar event five minutes early; we’ll paste the pad link in the invite and Marcus will start the pad. If anything changes, reply to this thread and we’ll re-route.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
